name: 9/11 Authorized Bus Parking Permit
description:
This dataset contains records of authorized bus parking permits issued around the September 11 commemorations, covering permit years 2011 through 2026. Each row represents a single permit and includes the permit number, reservation number, issue date, valid date, scheduled bus arrival time, and day of week. It also records the requesting organization's name, city, state, and ZIP code, along with the number of buses and permit quantity requested.

Vehicle details include vehicle type (mostly motorcoach, with some school buses, mini-buses, and vans) and bus company name. Permit terms are captured through the permit type (all special parking permits), condition restrictions (typically requiring a paid meter receipt), and a field indicating where the receipt should be placed. Return information shows whether a permit was returned, the quantity returned, and the return date.

The data could be used to analyze demand for bus parking over time, identify peak days and arrival times, examine the geographic distribution of requesting organizations, track
